title: draw_edit/1: an edit patch for a drawing
description: The patch `mzlab-cli mol draw SPEC --set edit=JSON|@PATH` applies to a drawing (also the `edit` member of the molkit `draw` request and of the app route `kind: "draw"`): a list of operations, or the object {"schema": "draw_edit/1", "ops": [...]}, applied in order, all or none. A failure is the error `err.mol.draw.edit` (exit 2) with the `index` of the operation, its `op`, a `reason` word and a `detail`; text that is not a patch is `err.mol.draw.editJson`. Atoms keep their id while the patch runs; coordinates the patch does not touch stay as they are. Stereo elements of atoms whose bonds changed are dropped and logged in `choices` (`edit_stereo_dropped`). At most 1000 operations, 65536 bytes as text, and the same for a list (counted as its compact JSON text, a number as 8 bytes; `err.mol.draw.editJson`), 2500 bonds and 2000 ids in a list; the choices and warnings it adds (`edit_added`, `edit_placed`, `edit_h_recounted`, `edit_stereo_dropped`, `edit_wedge_dropped`, `edit_valence`) are lists of scene atom indices. Code: crates/mzlab-feat/src/chem/edit.rs.
